title: 3D scan platform
subtitle: A steady orbit around your object
summary: Build Kass 3D’s camera rig, clamp your phone to the arm, and move it around the object for a steady scan.
instructions: The full kit with all six plates, as Kass 3D published it on MakerWorld (the designer’s own full-kit print profile, one 3MF), kept together in this project. Print each plate, then follow the designer’s assembly instructions. Keep the object still and move the phone slowly around it.

title: Vernier caliper with depth gauge
subtitle: Measure larger parts and depths
summary: The two-colour vernier caliper by 3D Print Masters Hub, in its 150 mm length, with its depth gauge.
instructions: The 150 mm colour caliper with its 150 mm DEPTH GAUGE, as 3D Print Masters Hub published them on MakerWorld (the designer’s two print profiles, both original 3MF files), kept together in this project. If the depth gauge is only offered for the 220 mm version, get the 220 mm caliper and its depth gauge instead. Print the body, slider and depth gauge, assemble them as the designer shows, and check measurements against a known ruler.
